title: flemingia nilgheriensis
intro: Flemingia nilgheriensis, commonly known as Nilgiri or Nilgiri stem, is a medicinal plant that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate fever, and treat respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Flemingia nilgheriensis include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Flemingia nilgheriensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
